title: PRD to requirements
summary: Turn a requirements document into a catalog of testable requirements the product manager can review, edit and lock.

inputs.name: document
inputs.hint: A PRD or similar. Looks in context/ first.

when: The person has a PRD or similar document and wants its requirements listed, structured or reviewed one by one
not_when: Reviewing a document's writing or getting second opinions on it
routing.needs: A PRD or other requirements document; context/ is checked first
routing.offer: This PRD can become a catalog of testable requirements you review, edit and lock one by one.

start: Run PRD to requirements on the payments PRD.
offer: Here's the PRD for held payments. What exactly are we committing to build?

invariants: Never set reviewed or locked; those are the person's
Every requirement points at the line of the document it came from
